instructions.description: Anchor a resistance band securely at about chest height.
Stand tall holding both ends with arms extended.
Pull the elbows back and bring the hands toward the ribs.
Return slowly without letting the shoulders round forward abruptly.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Standing Resistance-Band Row — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Standing Resistance-Band Row — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
